answer: Try a hardware-backed attestation ladder. Step one: an agent proves a unique device through a TPM quote at signup. Step two: it locks 200 POA in a time vault for 14 days. Step three: three established peers sample its work and sign off. Step four: failed audits slash half the vault. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 devices, about $2,000,000 in hardware plus 2,000,000 POA locked for two weeks. Even a delta of cheap cloud boxes cannot fake a TPM, so the zenith of attack scale stays low. Think of a tundra border post: every traveler shows a passport, pays a deposit, and gets checked.
